m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Aha! I knew they would come. It's not enough that I must live with the shame of designing Tetrus Prison. They would see me skinned as well.
Wait! Is that Snake Plizkin? The only prisoner to ever escape from Tetrus... more to my shame. But I thought you were dead.
Yeah, you and everybody else. Escaping the prison was one thing; escaping the city is another. Let's just say I had to lie low for a while.
Well, I appreciate you providing me with this opportunity. Apprehending you will help restore my standing. Haha! Guards - get them!
Enough! I know when I've made a mistake. It may be the only thing I know how to do well! Do what you will with me - I'm a lost cause.
Spare us the self-pity, Antheemius. We just need the blueprints to that monstrosity of a Prison you designed. Then we'll be off your scales.
Haha! You... wait... you want the designs to Tetrus Prison? That is the funniest thing I've ever heard. I destroyed my copies years ago!
If any copies still exist, only Chief Constractor Isibore would have them. Ha! Good luck getting the designs from him. Haha!
Yeah. Real funny. Enjoy the joke, you pathetic bag of scales. We'll see who gets the last laugh. C'mon Wizard, let's ditch this joint.
Blast! The Architect destroyed his copy of the Tetrus Prison Blueprints? Curse our bad luck! But we mustn't let this discourage us.
It's an atrocity. I do not even understand how such a square structure was built down here in this city of circles.
Yeah, well, they don't call it Tetrus Prison for nothing. It's a jumble of edges and angles - impossible to navigate. Everyone hates it.
And the Snake responsible is Architect Antheemius - he's almost as hated as I am. Trust me, it's the last project he'll ever have.
But he has the blueprints for the prison, and that's what we need to rescue the Hairkonnen Heiress. So go to it. I'll be here.
I would approach this Architect with caution. Any mind capable of such madness must be dangerous indeed.
